e3421d4a-c61f-5f2b-8dd0-1984d5c4e911.speaker: Margot
e3421d4a-c61f-5f2b-8dd0-1984d5c4e911.text: The relay crackles awake. A signal rises out of the static — do you answer it?
e3421d4a-c61f-5f2b-8dd0-1984d5c4e911.alt_text: A radio operator waits beside a glowing relay.

35dce5af-9522-58ef-a7af-7306f0fb7dbd.speaker: Voice
35dce5af-9522-58ef-a7af-7306f0fb7dbd.text: You pick up the receiver. Numbers, slow and deliberate — a code meant for you.

705a525d-b6e2-500b-b3d6-93a97465c4ce.speaker: Margot
705a525d-b6e2-500b-b3d6-93a97465c4ce.text: You let the dial fall silent. Some signals are not yours to answer. The end.

76aefd60-fef8-5f91-a1a7-8b62aa6ba85a.speaker: Margot
76aefd60-fef8-5f91-a1a7-8b62aa6ba85a.text: The numbers resolve into coordinates. Dawn shift just got interesting. The end.
